A.definition: Pinned BIL actual DexKit 2.3.0 usage: one shared resolveAll session, one bridge per distinct archive, all planned queries before closing that bridge
A.forbidden_distortion: Do not rebuild a bridge per query or disable real current shortcuts to inflate A cost

B.definition: DexKit with reviewed planner/lifetime/materialization optimizations, exactly the same source scope, 33-rule semantics, runtime profiles and accepted product projection as A

C.definition: DexMeguviz with the identical product request, source set, runtime profile, outcome and resource envelope
C.required_correctness: Full enabled-rule positive/negative/cardinality/partial and origin-aware verification gates before performance acceptance

comparison.attribution: A-to-B optimizer savings cannot be counted as C engine savings; report all three contrasts. Optimization effects are already included in totals and are not added again.
comparison.common_projection: Canonical accepted Method/Class/role-group descriptors and statuses after the same runtime verifier; preserve relatedClasses associations and side-effect profile. A/B lack of PC evidence must not be filled with invented native PC evidence.
comparison.additional_C_evidence: C fact/source/PC golden verification is a separate correctness gate. Independently derived A/B PC evidence is labelled with the deriving tool and its cost.

input_binding.APK_sources_ordered: Each base/split occurrence records slot, package, versionName/versionCode, byte length, SHA256 and immutable intake revision; duplicate bytes in distinct slots remain distinct occurrences.
input_binding.backend_builds: Each records source commit, dirty patch SHA256 or explicit clean marker, binary/APK/AAR SHA256, build flags and toolchain lock identity.
input_binding.device: Explicit chosen serial alias/model/SOC/RAM, ABI, OS build and page size; no identifier is inferred from a connected device without selection.
input_binding.identity_rule: Every raw record carries SHA256 of canonical run_identity and its exact backend build identity. Changes create a new protocol/campaign; do not pool across identity changes.

sampling.pair_definition: One block contains A, B, C on the same exact inputs and restored case state; 30 blocks yield 30 matched pairs for each contrast.
sampling.run_order_algorithm: Five copies of the six A/B/C permutations, shuffled once with Python random.Random(seed); explicit 30-order schedule below is authoritative.
sampling.warmup_policy: Fixed 5 pre-measurement triplets, retained as phase=warmup and never pooled with measured samples. Cold/native and L0 state reset is re-established after warmup.
sampling.tail_metric: Per-run frame p95 from the entire complete scripted capture; compare paired per-run p95 values, not IID individual frames.
sampling.p99: Not a release gate in v1. Report unverified; adding a p99 claim requires a new preregistration before observing the affected formal C data.
sampling.pooling: Never pool devices, APK identities, ABI, page sizes, modes, budgets or feature configurations. One campaign fixes one run_identity; each case reports separately.
sampling.warmup_run_order: Use the first five entries of the explicit run_order table in order, with phase=warmup and triplet_id 1..5; reset case state before each member.

cold_adaptation.state: Business result cache miss; native library/engine/snapshot unopened. OS page cache recorded separately, never called cold disk merely because app was force-stopped.

full_L0_hit.state: Complete verified business cache hit. No native scan load, whole-APK hash, source open, scan or index build is allowed on this path.

snapshot_warm_query.state: Existing immutable open snapshot; identical 10 query executions per run; retain individual timings, report their median plus full request accounting.

foreground_adaptation.state: The same cold adaptation executes concurrently with the selected repeatable foreground script; entire capture and all frame samples retained.

persistent_fact_hit.state: Only enabled after the persistent capability passes correctness. Cache identity/version/validation cost remains in prepare and full_task; disabled is not pass.

timing_envelopes.clock: Monotonic elapsed clock specified and locked in instrumentation identity; wall-clock timestamps only correlate evidence.
timing_envelopes.prepare_ms: Admission marker immediately before expensive preparation through query-ready state, including needed native load, strong identity/hash, immutable snapshot/copy, ZIP decompression, structural validation and required indexes.
timing_envelopes.first_answer_ms: Cumulative admission-marker-to-first-business-accepted-result time, including needed runtime verification and conversion; cannot report a raw candidate as accepted answer.
timing_envelopes.warm_query_ms: Median of the 10 retained warm_query_samples_ms on an already open snapshot, including query, required business verification and public-result conversion; no hidden prepare cost may migrate here.
timing_envelopes.full_task_ms: Admission marker to successful committed product outcome plus required cache persistence and synchronous job/source cleanup. Include native load, identity, parse, planned queries, business verification, conversion and required persistence uniformly in A/B/C. Necessary close/release is included.
timing_envelopes.close_ms: The required synchronous cleanup subinterval inside full_task; shared resident engine lifetime policy must be identical and separately labelled. Report post-close residual separately.
timing_envelopes.post_close_residual: Owned allocation ledger and observed PSS/RSS recorded before request, at peak, immediately after close and through fixed 1000ms post-close observation; residual time is not silently used to defer required cleanup.
timing_envelopes.nonadditivity: first_answer is cumulative and phase timers may overlap; do not add phase speedups or timer values to manufacture total savings.

metrics.memory_definition: Target host process only; maximum observed PSS during full_task minus median of 31 pre-admission PSS samples, clamped at zero. Sample at fixed 10ms cadence for every backend and retain timestamped samples/missed-sample counters. This is an observed sampled peak, not exact instantaneous allocator high water.
metrics.budget_scope: Owned allocator budget, address space, dependency allocations and observed RSS/PSS are distinct. State covered and excluded dependency allocations; no implicit reserve increase.

statistics.formula: For each complete valid triplet, log(metric_to/metric_from); exponentiate the arithmetic mean across 30 paired blocks. Pairwise absolute-difference gates use mean(to-from).

bootstrap.resampling_unit: triplet_id within one case; all backends stay paired
bootstrap.quantile_rule: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q on sorted bootstrap estimates

descriptive: paired ratio point estimate and 95% CI
paired absolute difference and 95% CI for absolute-tolerance gates
valid pairs, attempted records, missing/failed/excluded/warmup counts
statistics.zero_denominator: Time must be positive; zero baseline memory means ratio not estimable, never infinity or a fabricated win. Absolute memory values remain visible.
statistics.multiple_routes: Time and memory diagnostics use separate 95% confidence intervals; B-to-C thresholds and strict A-to-C time and memory superiority are required for overall acceptance. No joint familywise 95% coverage claim is made; thresholds cannot be invented or retuned after C results. Every required L0, warm and foreground case must also demonstrate strict C superiority against A and B; no familywise coverage claim is made.

decision_routes.decision: Correctness, lifecycle, reuse, complete-L0, warm and foreground gates must all pass. Report both diagnostics independently; overall acceptance requires both B-to-C primary time and memory thresholds, and both A-to-C time and memory 95% CI upper bounds strictly below 1. A memory-only result cannot compensate for a failed primary time threshold. In each required L0, warm and foreground case, paired C-minus-A and C-minus-B time-difference 95% CI upper bounds must be strictly below zero; equality or missing evidence fails. Existing absolute tolerances remain separately checked.

gates.correctness: All attempted formal records must be complete=true, status=ok, correctness_passed=true and accepted product projection SHA256 equal to independently frozen expected projection for the case. Any semantic error blocks this scope.
gates.absolute_tolerance_policy: Set numerical absolute tolerances before formal C data, based on timer resolution/product requirements or A/B-only calibration. No post-result adjustment. Use upper paired mean-difference CI against the tolerance.
gates.external_gate_policy: Matched immutable evidence identity is necessary; analyzer does not manufacture these gates from timing data. Missing evidence keeps overall acceptance unverified.

failures_exclusions_stopping.retain_all: Append-only raw records, including warmups, partial/error/cancelled/timeout runs and environmental exclusions. Never overwrite or delete a slow/failing row.
failures_exclusions_stopping.invalid_performance_samples: Exclude failed/incomplete/incorrect members and their whole triplet from successful-only estimates, but retain all attempt and failure counts. Any formal failure/exclusion/missing record blocks acceptance of the 30-triplet campaign.
failures_exclusions_stopping.stop: Fixed 30 measured triplets per case; no optional stopping at significance. Stop immediately on source/build drift, semantic mismatch, crash, budget breach or invalid safety/thermal condition; preserve partial campaign and failure reason.
failures_exclusions_stopping.rerun: No replacement of selected rows inside a campaign. After an identified fix or condition change, register a new campaign linked to the old one and rerun all 30 triplets for every affected case; retain failed campaign. Unchanged slow results alone are not rerun justification.

raw_schema.data_kind: real for actual captured runs; synthetic_control is always excluded from performance acceptance
raw_schema.external_gate_record: Each named gate is {status:passed, complete:true, identity_sha256, evidence_path, sha256}. evidence_path is relative to the raw file directory; analyzer rehashes the existing JSON evidence and verifies its identity/status/complete fields. A matched file is input evidence, not proof the analyzer ran the external gate.

current_limitations: No target device, exact APK campaign, A/B/C binary set, baseline B patch, foreground script or complete runtime gate evidence selected.
Absolute L0/warm/foreground/residual limits remain null and require selection before formal results.
P0-08 is in_progress; fixed statistical and relative-threshold draft is not final run authorization or a runnable formal benchmark runner.
